company.name: zeroheight
company.shortDescription: zeroheight is a DevOps platform that allows design teams to create up-to-date style guides and document their design system resources.
company.description:
Zeroheight is a software company developing a design documentation platform to easily build style guides and reuse common design elements. Its platform offers an easy-to-create design system to edit style guides that are synced with design and code to create beautiful and sophisticated style guides.

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in London, England.
